page.notes: Long s normalised to plain s throughout. The Greek in the Rom. 14.14 passage is copied as printed; the accents on κοινὸν δὲ ἑαυτῷ are not fully certain at this scan resolution. The fragment "tria." at the start of the first line is a word fragment from the previous page and is kept as printed. The large initial "Qui" is set in italic display type. The catchword "præfuit" is set at the right below the last line and is not repeated in the text.
